Finneon

Water

Sinnoh · Generation 4

Finneon is a Water-type Wing Fish Pokémon first found in Sinnoh (Generation 4). It stands 0.4 m tall and weighs 7 kg. It evolves into Lumineon. Its highest base stat is Speed (66), with a base stat total of 330.
